  - name (str): Logical orchestrator name. Defaults to "LLMOrchestrator".

  - workflow_client (Optional[wf.DaprWorkflowClient]): Dapr workflow client.

- Behavior:
  - Calls superclass constructor passing all configs plus a default state bundle from build_llm_state_bundle().

  - Initializes console text formatter.
